changelog:
- Enforced strict, mandatory use of this Skill as the exclusive entry point for all JiuwenSwarm deployment/startup/installation requests—no manual or direct commands permitted.
- Automated five-phase local deployment workflow: mirror download, extraction, configuration, service startup, and URL retrieval in the current Huawei Cloud development container.
- Secure credential and configuration handling; sensitive information never exposed or stored in plaintext.
- Clear error handling: automatic retries for each phase up to three times, manual fallback only after repeated failures.
- User requests with unsupported parameters (e.g., custom model, mirror URL, port, or non-local/Windows/etc. deployment) now trigger a capability explanation and require user confirmation before proceeding.
- Standardized, phased progress reporting and strict output formatting after successful deployment.
